title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: The small stuff matters
hook: Who is bringing snacks this Saturday?
intro: No one remembered the snacks, and three kids are upset.
statement: Small logistics shape how the season feels.
q1: Do you set a snack and job schedule for the season —
q2: or let parents sort out the small stuff?
q3: How much of your week goes to small details?
t1: Both can work. But you coach better
t2: when the small stuff runs without you.
cta: Coaches — who handles the small stuff?
ctaLines: A shared sign-up. A team parent. No snacks at all.
Set it up or let it sort itself out?
ctaPrompt: Share your team habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Who is bringing snacks this Saturday?
Game day comes. No one remembered the snacks, and three kids are upset.
Small logistics shape how the season feels.
A set schedule or let parents sort it out. There is no single right way.
Who handles the small stuff? Share your habit in the comments.
